name: @lgdl/web-cli-plugin
description: web-cli browser extension (MV3) — generic web-cli consumer for any site that declares the web-cli protocol; LGDL is one instance site

scripts.test: tsc test/*.test.ts --outDir dist-test --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --target es2022 --strict --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --declaration false --allowImportingTsExtensions --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');fs.mkdirSync('dist-test/test/ui',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync('test/ui/density-metrics.mjs','dist-test/test/ui/density-metrics.mjs')" && node --test dist-test/test/*.test.js
scripts.test:v3: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:supersession && npm run test:density && npm run test:l0 && npm run test:l1 && npm run test:ui && npm run test:insight && npm run test:binding && npm run test:hardening && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:gate-integrity && npm run test:l1-reverse
